title: Squid and white bean stew
summary: Squid and white bean stew is a mediterranean dinner built around squid rings and canned cannellini beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Squid and white bean stew. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add squid rings and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and canned cannellini beans.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until chopped tomatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Squid and white bean stew before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Squid and white bean stew.
